question: For each customer state group, show the state code, the number of orders and customers, total units sold, total sales, average and largest order amount, and delivered-order count; sort by total sales amount, highest first.
sql: SELECT c.st_cd AS state_code, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.cust_id) AS customer_count, SUM(o.qty) AS total_units, ROUND(SUM(o.amt),2) AS total_sales, ROUND(AVG(o.amt),2) AS average_order_amount, MAX(o.amt) AS largest_order_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.stat_cd=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_orders FROM cust_mst c JOIN ord_txn o ON o.cust_id=c.cust_id GROUP BY c.st_cd ORDER BY total_sales DESC
